text: In nineteen fifty-eight, an American bomber accidentally dropped an atomic bomb on a family's garden in South Carolina. A crew member climbed into the bomb bay to check a stuck locking pin. He grabbed the emergency release by mistake, and the bomb fell straight through the doors. The nuclear core wasn't on board. The ordinary explosives were. They blew a crater over twenty metres wide. Nobody was killed, but several of the family were hurt. Dave was standing on the bomb bay doors.
